note: Official names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this page, in our own words, with their sources named beside each trophy. Where no published guide has confirmed a method yet (19 Nov 2026), the guide says so instead of inventing one.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Chapters 1 to 4, then the final mission. The story trophies unlock as you play; none of them can be missed, and the stranger-mission finals unlock as you finish each character's strand. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Partner jobs and robberies
roadmap.text: Robberies open up in Chapters 3 and 4, and two of them need your partner beside you. Do these while the story is still fresh: they need a wanted level and a clean escape, which is easier before you are loaded with gear.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.text: The grind: stunts, races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games and challenges. Most of it counts toward 100% completion, so treat this as the main cleanup pass.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK It locations, vehicles and every corner of Leonida. Do the meditation spots early — one Chapter 1 spot disappears after that chapter, the only possibly missable trophy in the game.

roadmap.title: Money and properties
roadmap.text: Launder marked bills through your contacts, spend across the shops, and buy every garage. Money comes naturally from the story and robberies; don't grind cash until the story is done.

roadmap.title: Odd jobs and cleanup
roadmap.text: The one-offs: the airport, the tank, the bowling alley, the beach cocktail and the trophies whose triggers no guide has confirmed yet. Then check the 100% list and take the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are yours. There is no shortcut and no separate requirement — the platinum is purely a record that the whole list is done.
Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then robberies and activities, then collectibles, money and the odd jobs, and finish with A Long Road (100% completion). Budget around 200 hours in total; the published guides put the difficulty at 4 out of 10, so the platinum is long, not hard.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first story mission of the game, so this trophy unlocks naturally within your first session and cannot be missed.
Play it as the game teaches you: the mission introduces Lucia and Jason and the basic movement, driving and shooting you will use for the rest of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you play, so this one pops when the first chapter's final mission ends — just keep playing the gold story markers.
Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, and that spot disappears after this chapter. It is the one missable-adjacent step in the whole list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 2. By now both Lucia and Jason are playable, and most of the free-roam list opens up — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story: follow the gold markers to the chapter's end.
Chapter 2 is a good moment to start the long counters (stunts, races, WAiNK It locations) since the whole map is open to you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start to open up here, so once the chapter is done you can work on the bank vaults, the armored truck and the gang operations alongside the story.
Nothing in Chapter 3 is missable; if you are chasing the missable flag, the only spot that matters is the Chapter 1 meditation spot, already behind you.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Keep playing the story missions in order and this pops at the chapter's end.
Before the final mission, make a manual save. There is no mission replay, so a save here is your safety net for anything tied to the ending.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
Finish the final mission. It is the last story mission of the game and the second gold trophy; it unlocks the moment the credits roll.
Make a manual save before you start it — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so this save is the only way back to the pre-finale state. After the story, free roam carries on and the whole rest of the list stays open.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
Finish Breakfast Run, a story mission. Story-mission trophies unlock as you play them and cannot be missed: follow the gold marker, finish the mission, and the trophy pops.
If a story mission ever feels hard, remember there are no difficulty trophies — play on the standard settings and use cover and Combat Focus rather than rushing.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
Finish The Cartel Heist, a story mission. Like every story trophy it is unmissable: play the mission to its end and it unlocks.
Heist missions are the big set-pieces; they also pay well, which helps the money trophies (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self) later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
Finish Child's Play, a story mission. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
Story missions are also the steadiest way to open up the map and the side activities the rest of the list needs, so don't rush past them to grind counters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
Finish Headliners, a story mission. Unmissable: complete the mission and the trophy is yours.
The name is a nod to the mission itself — the hidden story trophies in this list all name the mission they come from.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
Finish VCIA Takedown, a story mission at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable.
The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can unlocks, so remember this location for the free-roam pass later — but the story trophy itself needs nothing extra.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
Finish Operation Savage Glory, a story mission. Unmissable: play it to the end.
This is one of the later story missions, so by the time it pops you will already have most of the chapter trophies behind you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the game and the last big gate before the platinum. The checklist lives under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and only appears after the story; everything you did before already counts toward it, and nothing on it is missable.
The published guides describe the checklist as a 35-task list covering story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration — in practice, if you follow this guide's roadmap and finish the activities, collectibles, robberies and exploration trophies, the 100% checklist fills itself in. Check it last, then mop up whatever rows are still open.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
Complete 250 stunts. A stunt is any trick jump, near-miss, long airtime or stylish driving move the game scores — chain them while driving around Leonida rather than hunting a single spot.
250 sounds like a lot, but stunts rack up passively across a 200-hour playthrough: jump the game's stunt jumps, take ramps at speed, and use fast cars on the highways. It counts toward 100% completion, so don't leave it for a separate grind if you can help it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
Try each type of activity once — all 9 activity types the game counts. Races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and the other pastimes as you unlock them: sampling one of each is enough, you don't need to master any of them.
This is a natural early trophy: as activities unlock through the story, try each one once and it pops. If it hasn't popped, check which activity type you haven't touched yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range challenge has a score target for gold; use a steady aim, fire in short bursts, and learn each challenge's layout — the targets are fixed, so a challenge you fail is one you can practice.
Gold all 42 and the trophy pops. This is one of the six silver trophies and a 100% completion item, so it is worth doing carefully rather than rushing: a gold medal needs accuracy, not speed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — all 14 of them. Drone races are flown from the Top Fun spots around Leonida; win one race at each location and the trophy pops.
Learn each course's gates before racing for the win: fly the course once slowly to memorize the turns, then race it. The drone handles the same everywhere, so the skill is the route, not the machine.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — street races, off-road, boat or air races as you find them — so work through the race markers around Leonida rather than replaying one favourite.
Races unlock through the story and the world; use the fastest vehicle you own for the race type and take the racing line instead of the shortest line. Wins also feed the stunt and challenge counters.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet at the fishing spots; challenge him and out-fish him — reel steadily, don't let the line snap, and match the fish's runs rather than fighting them.
Fishing challenges are one of the activity types, so this also ticks a row toward Master of None. If you lose, challenge him again — there is no limit on attempts.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start a game and play it to its end — any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy.
Arcade games are one of the activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. A completed game is what matters, not a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger characters whose mission strand runs through the game; finish every mission he gives you and this pops at the end of his strand.
Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so if Andy has nothing for you yet, play more story and come back. Nothing in a stranger strand is missable — they stay available in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand ends with this mission; finish his missions in order and the trophy pops.
Like the other stranger finals, it is unmissable and stays available after the story, so there is no rush — but his strand is also one of the eight that Strangers & Freaks counts.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand to its end.
Billy's strand is one of the eight stranger strands counted by Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it moves two trophies at once.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strangers are the side characters with their own mission chains — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others — and finishing any 8 of their strands earns this silver.
There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick the ones you enjoy; each finished strand also pops its own trophy. Strands unlock through the story and stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its end.
Randy's missions are part of the stranger set, so this also counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Unmissable and available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its end.
Another of the eight stranger strands — finish it alongside the others and Strangers & Freaks will pop with it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Meditate at every spot across Leonida — all 18 of them. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points around the map; stand at each one and meditate.
This is the one trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. For the other spots, work through the map in free roam after the story. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting; track the unique animal he wants — a rare spawn in the wilds of Leonida — and take it down.
The animal is unique, so it won't be one of the common herds: follow Bret's directions and the trail markers. This is one of the eight stranger strands, so it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect every card in any 3 sets and this silver pops.
Cards are a pure collectible: search the map methodically, area by area, and use the in-game tracking to see which sets are still incomplete. Three full sets are enough — you don't need every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-sharing app: open it at 100 different spots around Leonida and snap the location.
This is a sightseeing trophy in disguise — the fastest way is to tour the map deliberately, hitting landmarks, beaches, neighbourhoods and viewpoints. It pairs well with The Goodtime State (explore all of Leonida), so do them together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small scored tasks — driving, shooting, flying and world feats that tick off as you play. Fifty of them, of any kind, earns this.
Challenges complete passively across a long playthrough, so don't grind them early: play the story, the activities and the collectibles, and check the counter late. The last few are usually the deliberate ones — stunts, races and range medals.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
The trick is losing the cops, not getting the stars: use a fast car, break line of sight, then hide in an alley or change vehicles while the search cone shrinks. Do it with your partner in the car — solo escapes don't count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, then immediately rob two more without ever clearing your wanted level between them.
Plan a route: three shops close together, a fast getaway car parked outside, and your partner along. Don't stop to fight the police — rob, move, rob, move, and only lose the heat after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — any car, bike, boat or aircraft you get into for the first time counts toward the total.
This fills up naturally if you try everything you see instead of sticking to one car: steal a parked car here, a boat at the marina there, a plane at the airport. It pairs with On the Spot (register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode: trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in front of you and drop all five before it ends.
Set it up deliberately: find a gang shootout or a police standoff with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and work across the group with aimed shots. If you only get four, release and try again — there is no limit on attempts.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. The description is literal: leave the airport in an aircraft without a schedule, which in practice means taking a plane yourself and getting airborne.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026, so treat this as a free-roam stunt: go to VCIA, take a plane from the tarmac and take off. If it doesn't pop, check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is about them — the description reads as surviving the heat a Rhino brings, most likely by taking one for a drive or lasting through a military response in one.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. The honest route is to find a Rhino (military areas are the usual place) and use it in a wanted-level shootout; check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave without any guard or camera spotting you — silent movement, no alarms, no bodies found.
Scout first in free roam: learn the guard patrols and the camera angles, then do it in one clean pass. If you're spotted, leave and try again later; the trophy only counts a fully undetected run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape — the vault is the hard part, the getaway is the trophy.
Plan each one: a fast car, a route away from the police, and no lingering. Bank vaults open up in the later chapters, so this is a Chapters 3–4 trophy. Five successful escapes and the silver pops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, take the cash and get away clean.
Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida: block one in, break it open, grab the money and lose the wanted level. One successful escape is all it takes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you visit each named area; drive, sail and fly into every corner of the state until the counter is full.
Pair this with You WAiNKer! (100 WAiNK It locations) and Whip It Good (100 vehicles): one long sightseeing tour ticks all three. The last areas are usually the small islands and the far corners of the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops.
Learn which gang holds which turf, then work through the list methodically. Operations are marked in the world once you know what to look for, and each one is a short raid — get in, take it, get out.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is literal: go to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view.
No published guide has confirmed the exact spot or trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. The honest route is to visit the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and order a drink with the ocean in front of you; check the cited guides for the confirmed venue as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description reads as driving a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front — the classic GTA showroom smash.
No published guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. Find a vehicle showroom, take a car inside (or through the front), and drive out through the glass; check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game of bowling — the trophy's name is the follow-through of a bowling throw.
Any full game should count; play it to the end rather than quitting halfway. Bowling is also one of the activity types, so it ticks a row toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
A partnership with mass appeal. The wording points at your partnership — Lucia and Jason together — and at mass appeal, which reads as building a following or audience as a pair.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026, and this is the vaguest description in the list. Don't guess at it: check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down, and keep playing the partner activities in the meantime.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
Choices made (for better or worse). This trophy is about the choices you make through the story — dialogue choices and story decisions. PlayStation tracks a counter for it, reported to run to 500 choices, so it fills up simply by playing and choosing.
You can't rush it and you can't miss it: keep making choices — talk to people, pick dialogue options, decide when the story asks — and it pops in its own time, late in a long playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
Second time's the charm. The wording points at failing something and then passing it on the second attempt — a retry that succeeds.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. The best reading of the description is a second attempt at something you just failed; if it doesn't pop naturally during your playthrough, check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
What the hell just happened? The wording points at a strange encounter — the classic GTA easter egg, something out of the ordinary in the world of Leonida.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. Explore the odd corners of the map and watch for the unexplained; check the cited guides for the confirmed encounter as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description is literal: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon instead of a gun.
No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 Nov 2026. The practical attempt is to drive past a pedestrian and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle; check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; take them to your contacts and launder them into clean cash until the total hits $250,000.
Launder as you go — the story and the robbery trophies throw off marked bills steadily, so don't sit on a pile. Bank vaults and armored trucks are the best source.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car parts — anything sold in a shop counts toward the total.
Don't grind this: between weapons, ammo, clothes and vehicle upgrades, $100,000 goes by itself across a full playthrough. If you're short at the end, buy expensive weapon attachments or car upgrades.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles; buy every one on the market.
Garages cost money, so this is a late-game trophy: finish the story, count your cash, and buy the remaining garages in one pass. Each garage also gives you storage, so it's useful as well as collectible.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is the in-game vehicle service: register 10 different vehicles through it.
Register the cars you actually use plus a few you steal for the purpose — any 10 distinct vehicles count. It pairs with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): register as you discover.
